import AlgebraicJacobian.Descent.TensorProductFieldTowerMap
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.PicEtAffDescentReflection
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.PicEtTensorStageCover
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.RelPicFaithfullyFlatInjective
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.RelPicTensorStageFiniteStage

/-!
# Reflection of tensor-stage relative Picard equalities

An equality after scalar extension to the ambient algebraic field reflects to the
finite tensor stage carrying the relative Picard class.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory
open scoped TensorProduct

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

noncomputable section

set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000 in
-- Reassociating the finite-stage and ambient tensor maps is elaborator-intensive.
/-- A pair of scalar-extension maps agrees on the descended class when it agrees
after extending the class to the ambient algebraic field. -/
theorem RelPicTensorStageData.reflects_scalarExtension_pair_eq
    {M K B Q : Type u} [Field M] [Field K] [Algebra M K]
    [Algebra.IsAlgebraic M K]
    [CommRing B] [CommRing Q] [Algebra M B] [Algebra M Q]
    {C : Over (Spec (.of M))} (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 M) [IsAffineHom pi]
    [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    [GeometricallyReduced C.hom]
    {q : relPic C (overSpec M (K ⊗[M] B))}
    (D : RelPicTensorStageData pi q)
    (f g : B →ₐ[M] Q)
    (hq : relPicAlgMap C
        ((AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom
          (R := M) (K := K) f).restrictScalars M) q =
      relPicAlgMap C
        ((AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom
          (R := M) (K := K) g).restrictScalars M) q) :
    relPicAlgMap C
        ((AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom
          (R := M) (K := D.stage.stage) f).restrictScalars M) D.qStage =
      relPicAlgMap C
        ((AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom
          (R := M) (K := D.stage.stage) g).restrictScalars M) D.qStage := by
  let S := D.stage.stage
  let fS : (S ⊗[M] B) →ₐ[M] (S ⊗[M] Q) :=
    (AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom
      (R := M) (K := S) f).restrictScalars M
  let gS : (S ⊗[M] B) →ₐ[M] (S ⊗[M] Q) :=
    (AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom
      (R := M) (K := S) g).restrictScalars M
  let fK : (K ⊗[M] B) →ₐ[M] (K ⊗[M] Q) :=
    (AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom
      (R := M) (K := K) f).restrictScalars M
  let gK : (K ⊗[M] B) →ₐ[M] (K ⊗[M] Q) :=
    (AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom
      (R := M) (K := K) g).restrictScalars M
  letI algebraSQKQ : Algebra (S ⊗[M] Q) (K ⊗[M] Q) :=
    D.stage.tensorAlgebra (A := Q)
  letI towerMSQKQ : IsScalarTower M (S ⊗[M] Q) (K ⊗[M] Q) :=
    D.stage.tensorTower (A := Q)
  letI flatSQKQ : Module.FaithfullyFlat (S ⊗[M] Q) (K ⊗[M] Q) := by
    exact DatG0.tensorStageMap_faithfullyFlat
      (F := M) (K := K) (B := Q) D.stage.toFinSubext
  let jB : (S ⊗[M] B) →ₐ[M] (K ⊗[M] B) :=
    D.stage.tensorMap (A := B)
  let jQ : (S ⊗[M] Q) →ₐ[M] (K ⊗[M] Q) :=
    (Algebra.ofId (S ⊗[M] Q) (K ⊗[M] Q)).restrictScalars M
  have hf : jQ.comp fS = fK.comp jB := by
    convert (AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom_tower
      (F := M) (L := S) (K := K) f) using 1 <;> ext x <;> rfl
  have hg : jQ.comp gS = gK.comp jB := by
    convert (AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom_tower
      (F := M) (L := S) (K := K) g) using 1 <;> ext x <;> rfl
  have hinjQ : Function.Injective
      (relPicAlgMap (A := S ⊗[M] Q) (B := K ⊗[M] Q) C jQ) := by
    dsimp only [jQ]
    exact relPicAlgMap_faithfullyFlat_injective C
  apply relPicAlgMap_pair_eq_of_injective C jB jQ fS gS fK gK hinjQ hf hg
  rw [D.map_eq, D.map_eq]
  exact hq

end

end AlgebraicGeometry
